decisions.quote: On task effects in NLG corpus elicitation: A replication study using mixed effects modeling
decisions.reason: The paper collects a new sample of written Dutch image descriptions from 48 participants to re-test the modality effects reported by Van Miltenburg et al. (2018b), making it a replication.

decisions.reason: The authors report replicating the original Dutch finding that written descriptions contain more prepositions than spoken ones and agreeing with the original null findings for token length, PID, and adjectives, while all other modality effects disappeared in the controlled setting.
